rationale: Adds a compact structural recurrence change on top of the current reverse-tail baseline: the deepest recurrent pass still carries against the decoder-output anchor, while earlier recurrent tail blocks progressively refresh that anchor toward the already-updated tail state as their curriculum gain rises. This targets the stale-anchor failure mode without spending bytes on new tensors, keeps shapes compile-stable, and preserves the exact final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact path and logging markers.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Carry
